properties.description: Built 2026-10-20 (inference.rs inference_walk_full, without_dropped, step_without_dropped). The walk reaches every step that takes a lost node up in `assumed`; a claim whose every line still rests on a dropped assumption (not discharged on the way) reads unsupported in the what-if, one with another line reads still_supported with `still_holds_under`. A claim held only under the dropped assumption is reached but never counted lost, so a step that discharges the assumption above it (a reductio) is untouched. Trolley: dropping act consequentialism leaves the footbridge "push" verdict unsupported, and the bystander "turn" verdict standing on double effect (and redirect-a-threat, triple effect).
properties.name: A what-if on a principle the steps assume reads every position on it: which lose all support, which still hold and under what
